topic: Which company TPEx moved from 'Other Electronic' to 'Semiconductor' on 1 June 2026
disagreement: CLM-2188 (from an English AI rewrite of a CNA wire) names Gudeng. The original Chinese CNA report names 弘塑 (Grand Process Technology, 3131) and does not list 家登 (Gudeng, 3680).
possible_reasons: translation error in the tier-3 rewrite (弘塑 rendered as 'Gudeng')
rationale: The original-language CNA wire lists all 13 companies by Chinese name. 家登 is not among them, and 弘塑 is the company moved from 其他電子業 to 半導體業.
remaining_uncertainty: The TPEx announcement itself was not opened; the CNA wire is the original report used.
